data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2020 were GBP 1,548.182m. During 2020 the syndicate recorded prior-year favourable development (a net release) of GBP 51.972m (net) attributed to reassessment of prior accident year claims and favourable backyear reserve releases, particularly in the Casualty, Property and Marine areas. These favourable reserve developments were partially offset by significant COVID-19 related losses in several lines. No explicit gross prioryear movement total was disclosed, therefore the reported net prioryear surplus has been used as the quantified indicator.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves sourced from balance sheet (liabilities: claims outstanding). No explicit GROSS prioryear movement (PYD) amount was provided in the notes; the report explicitly states a NET prior-year surplus of GBP 51.972m which has been used as a fallback per instructions. The claims development triangle is present (gross and net), but extraction of a reliable gross PYD from the printed triangle was not performed due to table formatting ambiguity and potential distortions from reinsurance-to-close disclosures; therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m above is NET of reinsurance and not gross - users should treat this as a NET figure. Named event amounts are net where explicitly stated (COVID-19 GBP 194.1m net); most named catastrophe events are described qualitatively only ("broadly within expectations") and therefore amounts are null. The claims development triangle exists in the report (see page 35) but detailed per-cell extraction was not completed due to parsing ambiguity and risk of mis-transcription.
